name: slice denominator includes pending and unknown
input: slice denominator includes pending and unknown
test:
rows=[{'city':'SF','order_type':'food','status':s} for s in ['completed','pending','cancelled','mystery']]
rows += [{'city':'NY','order_type':'food','status':'completed'},{'city':'SF','order_type':'ride','status':'completed'}]
assert completion_rate(iter(rows),'SF','food')==.25
assert len(rows)==6 and rows[1]['status']=='pending'
print('ok')

name: empty all none duplicates and exact matching
input: empty all none duplicates and exact matching
test:
assert completion_rate([],'SF','food')==0.0
r={'city':'SF','order_type':'food','status':'completed'}
assert completion_rate((r for _ in range(3)),'SF','food')==1.0
assert completion_rate([r],'sf','food')==0.0
assert completion_rate([dict(r,status='Completed')],'SF','food')==0.0
assert completion_rate([dict(r,status='cancelled')],'SF','food')==0.0
print('ok')
